# load packages
```{r}
library(pacman)
pacman::p_load(ggplot2, tidyverse, readxl, glmmTMB, DHARMa, here)

```

# load data
```{r}

# oysters were dried at 100*C for 24-48 hrs
weights <- read_csv(here("data/Growth/Sizes/oyster_mass_data_master_06172026.csv"))
key <- read_xlsx(here("data/treatment_key.xlsx"))

weights2 <- left_join(weights, key, join_by("Bag" == "bag_num"))
weights2$top_bottom[is.na(weights2$top_bottom)] <- 0

```

# graph data
```{r}

weights2$top_bottom <- as.factor(weights2$top_bottom)

ggplot(weights2, aes(x= tide,y = Dry_Body_Mass_g, fill = top_bottom))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  theme_classic()


str(weights2)

```

# graph CI against each other
```{r}
weights2$dryshell <- weights2$Dry_Whole_Mass_g - weights2$Dry_Body_Mass_g

# CI from Maria's paper Estuarine community response to longline spacing in intertidal oyster culture (Dumbauld 2023)

weights2$CI <- weights2$Dry_Body_Mass_g/(weights2$Whole_Mass_g-weights2$dryshell)*100

ggplot(weights2, aes(x= tide,y = CI, fill = top_bottom))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  theme_classic()
```

# Run Bayesian model 
```{r}

MCMC_chains <- 1
MCMC_samples <- 100000
MCMC_burnin <- 1000
MCMC_thin <- 1

posterior_plots <- 100

basename <- "weights"

figure_height <- 5

options(width=128)
set.seed(0)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(nimble)
  library(nimbleExtra)
})

set_theme(theme_classic())


weights3 <- weights2 |>
  mutate(
    tb_idx   = as.integer(factor(top_bottom)),
    tide_idx = as.integer(factor(tide))
  )

# sparse = 1, bottom = 2, top = 3
# high tide = 1, low tide = 2

n_tb   <- n_distinct(weights3$tb_idx)
n_tide <- n_distinct(weights3$tide_idx)


message("===> MCMC code:")
MCMC_code <- nimbleCode({
  for (i in 1:n) {
    CI[i] ~ dlnorm(meanlog = mu[i], sdlog = sigma)
    mu[i] <- alpha[tb_idx[i], tide_idx[i]]
  }
  for (j in 1:n_tb) {
    for (k in 1:n_tide) {
      alpha[j, k] ~ dnorm(0, sd = 10)
    }
  }
  sigma ~ dunif(0, 50)
})

MCMC_monitors <- c("alpha", "sigma")
MCMC_constants <- list(n = nrow(weights3), n_tb = n_tb, n_tide = n_tide,
                        tb_idx = weights3$tb_idx, tide_idx = weights3$tide_idx)
MCMC_data <- list(CI = weights3$CI)
MCMC_initial_values <- list(alpha = matrix(0, n_tb, n_tide), sigma = 1)

mcmc_data <- nimbleMCMC(code=MCMC_code,
                        constants=MCMC_constants,
                        data=MCMC_data,
                        inits=MCMC_initial_values,
                        nchains=MCMC_chains,
                        niter=MCMC_iterations(MCMC_samples, MCMC_burnin, MCMC_thin),
                        nburnin=MCMC_burnin,
                        thin=MCMC_thin,
                        monitors=MCMC_monitors)
message()


```

#Graphing model results (mean of logCI)
```{r}
# selecting posterior plots
mcmc_samples <- mcmc_data |>
  samples() 
mcmc_samples_select <- mcmc_samples |>
  slice_sample(n=posterior_plots) |>
  print_dataframe("===> MCMC data: selected", output="str")

# probability that difference is different from zero 
message("Pr(diff between top and bottom low tide) < 0): ",100 * mcmc_samples |> probability((`alpha[3, 2]`-`alpha[2, 2]`) < 0), "%")
message("Pr(diff between sparse and bottom low tide) < 0): ",100 * mcmc_samples |> probability((`alpha[2, 2]`-`alpha[1, 2]`) < 0), "%")
message("Pr(diff between top and sparse low tide) < 0): ",100 * mcmc_samples |> probability((`alpha[3, 2]`-`alpha[1, 2]`) < 0), "%")
message("Pr(diff between top and bottom hi tide) < 0): ",100 * mcmc_samples |> probability((`alpha[3, 1]`-`alpha[2, 1]`) < 0), "%")
message("Pr(diff between sparse and bottom hi tide) < 0): ",100 * mcmc_samples |> probability((`alpha[2, 1]`-`alpha[1, 1]`) < 0), "%")
message("Pr(diff between top and sparse hi tide) < 0): ",100 * mcmc_samples |> probability((`alpha[3, 1]`-`alpha[1, 1]`) < 0), "%")
message()

  theme(text=element_text(size=20)) +
  ggtitle(title) +

  geom_rug(stat="sample_mean", sides="l")

figure_ia1
```

# making medians of CI
```{r}
mcmc_samples_med <- mcmc_data |>
  samples() |>
  mutate(
    med_CI_1_1 = exp(`alpha[1, 1]`),
    med_CI_2_1 = exp(`alpha[2, 1]`),
    med_CI_1_2 = exp(`alpha[1, 2]`),
    med_CI_2_2 = exp(`alpha[2, 2]`),
    med_CI_3_1 = exp(`alpha[3, 1]`),
    med_CI_3_2 = exp(`alpha[3, 2]`),
    tb_lo = med_CI_3_2-med_CI_2_2,
    ts_low = med_CI_3_2-med_CI_1_2,
    bs_low = med_CI_2_2-med_CI_1_2,
    tb_hi = med_CI_3_1-med_CI_2_1,
    ts_hi = med_CI_3_1-med_CI_1_1,
    bs_hi = med_CI_2_1-med_CI_1_1,
  )

```

# Traditional OLS
```{r}
model1 <- glmmTMB(CI ~ tide*top_bottom +(1|Bag), data = weights2, family = lognormal())
summary(model1)
testDispersion(model1)
tst_simres <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = model1) #DHARMa
plot(tst_simres)
car::Anova(model1, type = "III")
```
